items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 52:1
items.html: For the phase of the coupling and the middle line of the Rosh is Daat. And since the coupling of the days of pregnancy is in the inclusion of AVI, and not in the phase of ZA himself, therefore there is no phase of Daat there.
